Evidence: The Delhi High Court ruled that Rule 89(4) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017 is not applicable to refunds of integrated tax paid on zero-rated supply. This was confirmed in the case of Ohmi Industries Asia Private Limited, where the court stated that Rule 89(4) applies only to zero-rated supplies made without payment of tax under bond or letter of undertaking. Therefore, the provisions do not apply to cases involving refunds of integrated tax paid on zero-rated supplies (Source 1 and Source 2).
Justification: The retrieved evidence clearly states that the Delhi High Court has held Rule 89(4) of the CGST Rules to be inapplicable for refunds of integrated tax paid on zero-rated supplies. This directly corroborates the claim that the court ruled on this specific issue, confirming the core assertion of the claim based on the evidence from Source 1 and Source 2.
